script.topic: I Built the App I Wish Existed - MoneyMama
script.script:
[VISUAL: Cinematic dark opener]
3 AM. Kids asleep.

[VISUAL: Emotional text]
You're staring at your bank account trying to figure out which bill to push.

[PACE: Slow down]
I've been there more times than I want to count.

[VISUAL: Problem statement]
Every finance app assumes two incomes. None built for us.

[VISUAL: Turn moment - gold]
So I built it.

[VISUAL: App reveal]
MoneyMama. AI financial coaching for single mothers.

[VISUAL: Features]
Tracks your budget. Your co-parenting expenses. Your emergency fund.

[TONE: Emotional - personal]
Talks to you at 3 AM when you're spiraling. Doesn't judge. Just helps.

[VISUAL: Urgency]
First 100 on the waitlist get VIP access completely free.

[VISUAL: Call to action]
Link in my bio. Come build this with me.
